$comment: GUMSHOE investigative abilities converted to CWN skills (#932). Source: GUMSHOE SRD (OGL), 'Investigative Abilities' and 'Gathering Clues'. Each entry names the CWN skill an investigator uses when the ability is not on their sheet, so a character who never bought GUMSHOE abilities can still work the case. General abilities are deliberately absent: CWN's own skills are the general layer, and this file must not become a second skill list.

abilities.name: Research
abilities.notes: Library, archive, records. The default way to turn a name into a file.

abilities.name: Textual Analysis
abilities.notes: Who really wrote it, what was removed, what the format gives away.

abilities.name: History
abilities.notes: Institutional memory: which agency did what, and what it was called then.

abilities.name: Law
abilities.notes: Jurisdiction, warrants, and which of the three badges actually authorises this.

abilities.name: Occultism
abilities.notes: Cults, syncretic movements, noetic claims. Distinguishes belief from evidence.

abilities.name: Forensic Pathology
abilities.notes: Cause, time, and what the body disagrees with the report about.

abilities.name: Biology
abilities.notes: Non-human tissue, contamination, the plausibility of a claim about a specimen.

abilities.name: Cryptography
abilities.notes: Ciphers and signatures. Feeds the node-link layer; never replaces it.

abilities.name: Data Retrieval
abilities.notes: Finding the record that exists. Access is a separate question, answered by hacking.

abilities.name: Evidence Collection
abilities.notes: Scene search. The clue is there; the search finds it.

abilities.name: Chemistry
abilities.notes: Substances, residues, and what a lab can honestly tell you.

abilities.name: Reassurance
abilities.notes: Witness care. Often the only way a frightened person says anything.

abilities.name: Streetwise
abilities.notes: Who to ask, and what not to ask them.

abilities.name: Bureaucracy
abilities.notes: Which form unlocks the door, and who has to sign it.
